body: Created EMILY/context/golden-docs-index.md (18 Tier 1 sources). Modified goldenbuild.go NewGoldenDocCompiler to call loadGoldenIndex — reads manifest at startup, falls back to hardcoded list if absent. Same manifest loader added to emily.cli/cmd/context.go. Adding a new golden doc now requires only appending a row to the index file, no Go change.
title: S22-11: golden-docs-index.md manifest + manifest-driven goldenbuild
